perspective:
Bradley Ochoa’s available information:

- He is a salesperson at a marketing firm and knows Katherine Lasiloo as the marketing manager/colleague.
- He experiences their professional relationship as cordial but sometimes strained by differing views on sales and marketing strategy.
- In the meeting room, he has prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support his belief in traditional sales techniques.
- He tells Katherine he appreciates her innovative digital strategies but believes core sales could benefit more from traditional methods.
- He hears Katherine say the market is evolving, digital outreach has potential, and they should balance and analyze data together.
- He expresses frustration that proven traditional methods feel sidelined without proper consideration.
- After the meeting, he hears Katherine share recent digital campaign success stories that boosted engagement and sales.
- He asks Katherine to explain how those digital strategies are developed.
- He hears Katherine explain targeting the right audience/message and walking through analytics and decision-making.
- He admits he had doubts about moving away from traditional methods but now wants to understand the digital approach.
- He hears Katherine say she is glad he is open, that adapting/evolving matters, and that they should dive deeper into data.
- He proposes a joint strategy meeting to integrate traditional and digital marketing.
- He hears Katherine agree, say combining strengths could improve results, and suggest scheduling a brainstorm/outline session.
- He expresses hope that leveraging both their expertise will create something impactful and appreciates Katherine’s willingness to collaborate.
- He hears Katherine say she looks forward to it and wants to leverage each other’s strengths.
- After the joint meeting, he works overtime to prepare a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas.
- He feels excited and convinced the integrated approach will set them apart from competitors.
- He hears Katherine say the draft looks comprehensive/well thought out and that his hard work shows.
- He hears Katherine say she is confident they will succeed and suggests going through it once more to fine-tune.
- After the presentation and implementation, he tells Katherine he is grateful, has learned from her, and has experienced professional growth through their collaboration.
- He proposes regular strategy sessions to continue collaborating.
- He hears Katherine say the project’s success was a pleasure, his openness helped make the partnership successful, and regular sessions are a fantastic idea to stay on top of their game and market trends.
